dialogues.speaker: Newscaster
dialogues.jp:
『次は、枯れない桜の花が散ってしまうという、
　ショッキングなニュースです』
dialogues.en:
"Next up, we have some shocking news on the unwithering
sakura petals."
dialogues.text:
"Next up, we have some shocking news on the unwithering
sakura petals."

dialogues.jp:
耳を疑い、かぶりついたトーストをそのままに、
テレビに目を向ける。
dialogues.en:
My ears picked up at the words, as I turned away from my
toast and to the TV.
dialogues.text:
My ears picked up at the words, as I turned away from my
toast and to the TV.

dialogues.speaker: Newcaster
dialogues.jp:
『散らない桜が咲く島として有名な初音島で、
　桜の木の花が散っているのが今朝、桜公園を
　散歩していた男性によって発見されました』
dialogues.en:
"A man passing by the giant sakura tree has alerted us that
the giant sakura tree, famous in hatsunejima, has lost it's
petals."
dialogues.text:
"A man passing by the giant sakura tree has alerted us that
the giant sakura tree, famous in hatsunejima, has lost it's
petals."

dialogues.jp:
……今度は、目も疑わなければならなくなった。
残りは、正気か電波しかない。
dialogues.en:
...I couldn't believe what I was hearing, but the news then
brought us a visual.
dialogues.text:
...I couldn't believe what I was hearing, but the news then
brought us a visual.

dialogues.jp:
見慣れた桜の大木。しかし、その姿は、まるで
見慣れないものだった。
dialogues.en:
It was the ever-present giant sakura tree. However, I was
seeing it in a way I had never seen it before.
dialogues.text:
It was the ever-present giant sakura tree. However, I was
seeing it in a way I had never seen it before.

dialogues.jp: 花びらが、散ってしまっている。
dialogues.en: Shed of all it's petals.
dialogues.text: Shed of all it's petals.

dialogues.jp: 「そんな、バカな……」
dialogues.en: "How can that be..."
dialogues.text: "How can that be..."

dialogues.jp: 半ば呆然と呟く。
dialogues.en: I murmured in amazement.
dialogues.text: I murmured in amazement.

dialogues.speaker: Newscaster
dialogues.jp:
『原因については現在、全く判っておらず、島
　の研究機関が原因の調査を……』
dialogues.en:
"The reason for this is currently unknown, however, the
island's research centre are working on their
investigation..."
dialogues.text:
"The reason for this is currently unknown, however, the
island's research centre are working on their
investigation..."

dialogues.jp:
口調も変えず、ニュースキャスターは次の話題
を提供する。
dialogues.en:
With a sudden change of tone, the newcaster moved on to the
next news story.
dialogues.text:
With a sudden change of tone, the newcaster moved on to the
next news story.

dialogues.jp: パチンッ――。リモコンのスイッチを押した。
dialogues.en: I switched the television off with the remote control.
dialogues.text: I switched the television off with the remote control.

dialogues.jp:
「……まあ、火山が噴火したわけでもなし、気
　にしても仕方がないか」
dialogues.en:
"...Well, this isn't a volcanic eruption or something,
shouldn't worry about something that's already happened."
dialogues.text:
"...Well, this isn't a volcanic eruption or something,
shouldn't worry about something that's already happened."

dialogues.jp:
というか、気にしたところで、何が出来るはず
もない。
dialogues.en:
Although I said that, a tiny part of me couldn't help
worrying.
dialogues.text:
Although I said that, a tiny part of me couldn't help
worrying.

dialogues.jp:
たとえ、世界で一番優秀な樹医だとしても、ど
うしようもないんじゃないだろうか。
dialogues.en:
After all, this isn't the world's biggest and most famous
sakura tree for nothing.
dialogues.text:
After all, this isn't the world's biggest and most famous
sakura tree for nothing.

dialogues.jp:
あの桜は、ただの桜じゃない──なかった──
のだから。
dialogues.en: Those sakura petals -- they aren't normal sakura petals.
dialogues.text: Those sakura petals -- they aren't normal sakura petals.

dialogues.jp: 「……おっと。遅れる遅れる」
dialogues.en: "...Whoa, I'm going to be late!"
dialogues.text: "...Whoa, I'm going to be late!"

dialogues.jp:
桜が枯れた事は、遅刻の理由にはならないだろ
う。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei won't exactly accept thought over the wilting
sakura petals as an acceptable excuse for tardiness.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei won't exactly accept thought over the wilting
sakura petals as an acceptable excuse for tardiness.

dialogues.jp: 前に後ろに、風見学園の学生達が歩いている。
dialogues.en:
I walked to Kazami Academy, with it's students behind and in
front of me.
dialogues.text:
I walked to Kazami Academy, with it's students behind and in
front of me.

dialogues.jp:
時折耳に会話が飛び込んでくるのだが、その話
題は決まって──。
dialogues.en:
As I casually overheard some of their conversations, the
subject was obvious.
dialogues.text:
As I casually overheard some of their conversations, the
subject was obvious.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.jp:
「ねえねえ、あの桜が枯れちゃったらしいよ。
　信じられないよね〜」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, have you heard? Those sakura petals have withered...
it's unbelievable!"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, have you heard? Those sakura petals have withered...
it's unbelievable!"

dialogues.jp: 自分に置き換えてみればよく分かる。
dialogues.en: I knew exactly what she was feeling.
dialogues.text: I knew exactly what she was feeling.

dialogues.jp:
誰だって、寝て覚めてみたら、丸坊主の自分を
発見した──なんて状況、信じたくはないだろ
う。
dialogues.en:
Anyone who just woke up from sleep to see the sight of that
bald giant sakura tree; it's nearly impossible to believe.
dialogues.text:
Anyone who just woke up from sleep to see the sight of that
bald giant sakura tree; it's nearly impossible to believe.

dialogues.jp:
けど、今回の神の見えざるバリカンは、自分を
標的にしたわけではないし、ましてや、元々が
異常だったものを、正常へと正したのだ。
dialogues.en:
But now, God had taken his scissors and returned what was an
abnormality in the world back to normalcy.
dialogues.text:
But now, God had taken his scissors and returned what was an
abnormality in the world back to normalcy.

dialogues.jp: そんなわけで──。
dialogues.en: And that's why--
dialogues.text: And that's why--

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「ま、とうとうくたばったんだろ。負けた途端
　老人になっちまった、最凶死刑囚みたいな？」
dialogues.en:
"Bah, no use talking about crap like that. It just finally
gave up, that's all."
dialogues.text:
"Bah, no use talking about crap like that. It just finally
gave up, that's all."

dialogues.jp:
聞こえてくる声は、どれもこれも、楽しげで、
無責任で、脳天気なものだった。
dialogues.en:
The next voice I heard was a particularly uncaring one, full
of self-enjoyment and irresponsibility.
dialogues.text:
The next voice I heard was a particularly uncaring one, full
of self-enjoyment and irresponsibility.

dialogues.jp: まあ、俺もその一員なんだけど。
dialogues.en: Well, I can't say I'm not like that sometimes either.
dialogues.text: Well, I can't say I'm not like that sometimes either.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、ことり、おはよっす」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Kotori, morning."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Kotori, morning."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ……朝倉君。その……おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Ah... Asakura-kun. Umm... good morning."
dialogues.text: "Ah... Asakura-kun. Umm... good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「なあなあ、テレビ見た？　あの桜が枯れたっ
　てさ」
dialogues.en: "Did you see, on TV? The sakura petals have withered."
dialogues.text: "Did you see, on TV? The sakura petals have withered."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん……見たよ」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah... I saw."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah... I saw."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何か、びっくりだよな。あれが枯れるなんて。
　物心ついた時から、ずっと咲いてたし」
dialogues.en:
"It's so surprising to see them all withered like that. In
my mind, I thought it would be blooming forever."
dialogues.text:
"It's so surprising to see them all withered like that. In
my mind, I thought it would be blooming forever."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、あれだ。これで、来年の花見がぐっと楽
　しみになったよな。はは……は？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I guess this means we have to postpone any more
flower-viewing sesssions for next year, haha...ha?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I guess this means we have to postpone any more
flower-viewing sesssions for next year, haha...ha?"

dialogues.jp:
どうしたんだろう？　ことりの奴、ずっと浮か
ない顔してるけど……。
dialogues.en: What's happening? She's looking oddly depressed today...
dialogues.text: What's happening? She's looking oddly depressed today...

dialogues.en: "...Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "...Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだよ？　元気ないように見えるけ
　ど……頭痛か？」
dialogues.en:
"What's wrong? You're looking down... are you having a
headache again?"
dialogues.text:
"What's wrong? You're looking down... are you having a
headache again?"

dialogues.jp:
前にことりは、頭痛持ちだって言っていた事が
ある。
dialogues.en:
Remembering Kotori's problems with it before, I brought it
up again as a possible reason.
dialogues.text:
Remembering Kotori's problems with it before, I brought it
up again as a possible reason.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん……頭は、痛くない……」
dialogues.en: "No... my head is fine..."
dialogues.text: "No... my head is fine..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、寝不足とか？」
dialogues.en: "Lack of sleep, maybe?"
dialogues.text: "Lack of sleep, maybe?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なんでもないよ」
dialogues.en: "No, that's not it..."
dialogues.text: "No, that's not it..."

dialogues.jp: ことりは緩く首を振った。
dialogues.en: Kotori slowly shook her head.
dialogues.text: Kotori slowly shook her head.

dialogues.jp: 「なら、いいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Well then..."
dialogues.text: "Well then..."

dialogues.jp: 「何かあった時は言ってくれよな」
dialogues.en:
"If you really have any problems, don't be afraid to tell
me."
dialogues.text:
"If you really have any problems, don't be afraid to tell
me."

dialogues.jp: ことりは小さくうなずくのだった。
dialogues.en: Kotori gave me a slow, short nod.
dialogues.text: Kotori gave me a slow, short nod.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉よ。俺は今、久方ぶりに身体を突き上げ
　るような興奮を感じているぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura. Right now, I feel the excitement of my body pushed
up against yours."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura. Right now, I feel the excitement of my body pushed
up against yours."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺にそれを訴えなくていいぞ」
dialogues.en: "Any more words and I'd file a lawsuit."
dialogues.text: "Any more words and I'd file a lawsuit."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお！　みなまで言わなくても、分かってく
　れるのかお前は。さすが俺の友！」
dialogues.en:
"Ohh! Brilliant work my friend, you got my meaning the first
time!"
dialogues.text:
"Ohh! Brilliant work my friend, you got my meaning the first
time!"

dialogues.jp: 杉並は去っていった。
dialogues.en: Suginami left for his desk.
dialogues.text: Suginami left for his desk.

dialogues.jp: 「……なんなんだ？　あいつは……」
dialogues.en: "...What the hell's wrong with him?..."
dialogues.text: "...What the hell's wrong with him?..."

dialogues.jp: ふと、ことりに視線を向けた。
dialogues.en: My mind quickly focused back on Kotori.
dialogues.text: My mind quickly focused back on Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
席に着いたことりは、いつものように誰かと喋っ
たりはしていなかった。
dialogues.en:
She was just quietly sitting at her desk. Normally she'd be
lively talking to our classmates at this time.
dialogues.text:
She was just quietly sitting at her desk. Normally she'd be
lively talking to our classmates at this time.

dialogues.jp:
机に肘を突き、両手を額に押しつけて、じっと
机に顔を向けている。表情は窺えない。
dialogues.en:
Her elbows were on the desk, her two hands supporting her
forehead. Her face stared straight into the desk,
expressionless.
dialogues.text:
Her elbows were on the desk, her two hands supporting her
forehead. Her face stared straight into the desk,
expressionless.

dialogues.jp: どうしたんだろうな、本当に。
dialogues.en: Really, what's wrong with her...?
dialogues.text: Really, what's wrong with her...?

dialogues.jp: ◆枯れた桜◆
dialogues.en: ◆Withered Sakura Petals◆
dialogues.text: ◆Withered Sakura Petals◆

dialogues.jp: 枯れない桜が枯れたらしい。マジか……？
dialogues.en:
It seems like that unwithering sakura petals had, well,
withered. Was it true...?
dialogues.text:
It seems like that unwithering sakura petals had, well,
withered. Was it true...?

dialogues.jp: しかしそんな事とは関係なく学園はある。
dialogues.en: But that weird occurence had nothing to do with school.
dialogues.text: But that weird occurence had nothing to do with school.

dialogues.jp:
教室に着く前ことりと会ったのだが、何故か元
気がないようだった。頭痛だろうか……？
dialogues.en:
I met Kotori in front of the classroom, but she seemed
depressed. Is she having a headache...?
dialogues.text:
I met Kotori in front of the classroom, but she seemed
depressed. Is she having a headache...?
